rationale: Thresholds pin the current deterministic baseline of the gated core V4 corpus (ordinary clinical prose + false-positive guards + the AGE taxonomy). The corpus is intentionally small: one missed detection, one spurious detection or one wrong AGE band must fail the gate. This mirrors the accepted legacy privacy-eval gate rationale (scripts/privacy-eval/config.json) and reuses the exact same metric definitions; it is a regression gate, not a quality grade. Adversarial cases are reported as known gaps and never gate. Any corpus addition must re-evaluate these thresholds explicitly in the corresponding ticket.
